body.x: HUAWEI(www.huawei.com) unveiled a premium smart watch ‘Jewel’ at ‘Digital Experience!’ which ran Jan. 5 in Las Vegas. 'Digital Experience!' is an annual event only for media, held by Pepcom before the opening of CES. At the event, more than 1,500 journalists had a time to cover CES opening ceremony and startup products in advance.HUAWEI cooperated with Swarovski to showcase a premium smart watch ‘Jewel’ which has beautiful design and superior abilities. It interworks with other devices, getting a message and a phone call alarm.It has various abilities like Bluetooth connection and heart rate monitoring sensor. Rose-gold color and 68 Zirconia cubic of Swarovski were used for the best design.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.→ Go to 'CES 2016' News page
